Corporate loan applications need extensive documentation,
which means waaaaaay too many documents to review.
[sigh]
A loan officer may spend over an hour staring at details on the screen,
while the loan customer anxiously waits on the other end for any news of approval.
Even worse, when bad actors are involved,
smaller anomalies are even harder to catch.
So that's why we introduce...
the G-L-D-B Anomaly Detection Portal.
Agents read every document,
and flag what doesn't add up.
First step, upload the documents.
Every file is classified, and its key fields read.
Even from scans.
Next step, agents investigate every document. A lead agent directs its specialists across metadata, fonts, and alignment.
That way, a doctored figure or mismatched address gets caught.
And it's not a black box.
The agent trace shows every step, every tool call, and what it returned.
Every finding can be audited.
Next step, every case gets a risk rating,
with the exact evidence behind it.
What was flagged, where, and why.
Officers confirm or dismiss each finding, and add notes.
And it recommends the documents that would settle it.
Finally, lock the case.
Finalised cases become view-only, with every step on record.
Every case, at a glance.
The whole pipeline, from upload to finalised.
The most common flags, across every case.
Risk across every case in view.
And the riskiest cases first.
What took hours of screening now takes minutes.
The AI does the reading. Your loan officers make the call.
And customers hear back sooner.
Bring your next loan case.
G-L-D-B Anomaly Detection Portal.
Try it out today.
